No ticket was submitted; Cancel Request used to leave forms. Session rebuilt once after an inactivity timeout (environment).

cases.actual: Help tab: Help & Support / How can we help you?; toggle Raise a Support Request (selected) / My Support History; Trip-Based Support card (Live trip issues, Faster response, Raise Ticket) and General Complaint card (Non-urgent, Response within SLA, Submit Feedback); Frequently Asked Questions grouped by Booking & Inquiry, Pricing & Payments.
My Support History (no tickets): Your support history will appear here once you raise a ticket.

Raise Ticket opens Trip-Based Support form: Booking ID (Select Booking ID), Title, Request Type, Service Type, Date (dd/mm/yyyy), Assign To (Select Role), Priority (Medium default), Status (Open default), Description; Submit Complaint and Cancel Request at the bottom.

Booking ID dropdown opens no list (tapped field and arrow, waited 5 s) although the account has 26+ inquiries in My Bookings; no booking can be selected, so a trip-based ticket cannot be linked to a trip. OBS-22 still present.

Request Type and Service Type dropdowns open no options in either the Trip-Based Support form (focus border only, no list after 5-7 s). Mandatory classification fields cannot be filled. OBS-22 still present.
Priority dropdown lists Low / Medium (selected) / High.

Customer-facing form lets the user set Assign To with internal staff roles (Super Admin, Admin, Operations, Garage Supervisor, Finance...) and an editable Status dropdown (default Open). Customers should not choose the assignee or status. OBS-23 still present.

Trip-Based Support form scrolls (touch swipe) to Description, Submit Complaint and Cancel Request - all fields and the submit button reachable (OBS-24 not reproduced; the stream needs a moment to update). Observation: trip-based ticket button is labelled Submit Complaint, same as General Complaint.

No length limit or character counter: Title accepted ~170 characters (Trip-Based form) and Description ~175 characters (General Complaint) without truncation or message. No maximum is enforced or communicated (exact spec limit not documented). Form was not submitted (not approved).

Submit Feedback opens General Complaint: Title, Request Type, Service Type, Date, Assign To, Priority (Medium), Status (Open), Description; no Booking ID; Submit Complaint / Cancel Request. Cancel Request returns to Help without creating a ticket (My Support History still empty).

FAQ accordion: How do I submit a new inquiry? and How is the trip fare calculated? expand to show the answer and collapse on a second tap (chevron toggles); other questions listed under Booking & Inquiry and Pricing & Payments.
Ticket Date picker allows future dates: selected 07-10-2026 (tomorrow; wheel also offers 2027) and it is accepted in the field. Issue date should not be in the future.
